Both handle a big library fine, and I'm glad the search box stays right there at the top either way so I can hunt across everything no matter how far down I've scrolled.

For just browsing, revealing more in the same list feels a bit more natural to me — I keep scrolling and older ones keep appearing, without stopping to jump between page numbers. Honestly though, either would be fine; for the way I actually find things I'll mostly lean on search and tags anyway. So my mild preference is "reveal more in the same list."
